answer: Each identity starts at dawn with zero standing and must earn it: every epoch it posts a small refundable bond plus proof of completed work verified by two unrelated peers. Standing accrues slowly, like a tide, and decays if the agent goes idle, so a Sybil farm must keep paying bonds and doing real work for every clone. An opal check, a random audit where the agent must reproduce its claimed work from its own logs, burns the bond of any identity that cannot, making a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds and a thousand audits.
